notes: Oven-rack finish and oven design vary, so the owner's manual controls whether racks may remain in a self-clean cycle. Use soap-and-water cleaning as a conservative default for standard chrome racks. Do not tell readers to use self-clean with racks unless their model specifically permits it, and do not recommend commercial oven cleaner universally because finishes can discolor or be damaged.
